widgets_values: 参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就关掉下面的开关

如果只要单采那就不要开启二阶段采样，分辨率选择器里选择你要的分辨率大小，推荐0.9，直出720p视频。
如果要开二阶段采样，那一阶段的分辨率就要调小，推荐0.4，先用低分辨率快速跑完一采，然后再用较低的步数再二次采样，此时二次采样就可以将分辨率拉高，根据自己的配置和需求来调（太高了也会影响速度）

PS：本地跑的话，可以先不开二采，先用一采来快速抽卡，抽到满意的，把种子锁定然后开二采来强化。

混合限制‌：
所有素材（图 + 视频 + 音频）混合输入时，总数不得超过‌12 个‌！！

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic, live-action sci-fi style with cool-blue and warm-amber practical lighting, shallow depth of field, and atmospheric haze inside the corridor.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot establishes <Subject 1>, the narrow sci-fi industrial corridor from <Picture 1>, with its metallic wall panels, overhead ducts, alternating blue overhead and amber wall-floor LED strips, sealed side doors, and the distant "L04"-marked blast door framing the back of the passage. The air carries thin haze that catches the LED glow. <Subject 2> enters from the right side of the frame, her footfalls echoing on the polished floor as she walks toward the center of the corridor with a guarded, deliberate pace. She slows, turns slightly, and looks back over her shoulder down the way she came.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot from the opposite side, with the "L04" door still visible in the deep background. <Subject 3> steps out from the shadow of a wall panel on the left side of the corridor and faces <Subject 2> across a few meters of open floor. He raises one hand in a low, restrained greeting, palm toward her.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts to a tight two-shot of <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> facing each other in profile, the corridor's blue overhead light raking across their faces and amber light glowing along the floor edge beneath them. <Subject 2>, speaking in a controlled, breathy whisper (S1), says: <d>[Chinese] 你怎么找到这里的？</d> <Subject 3>, replying in a low, steady male voice (S2), answers: <d>[Chinese] 走廊尽头的门禁密码，有人发给我了。</d> He glances past her toward the "L04" door in the distance. <Subject 2> (S1) whispers: <d>[Chinese] 那我们只有一次机会。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle close-up framing the "L04" blast door at the end of the corridor, its central panel still dark. A small green status LED beside the door lock blinks twice, then the panel emits a rising electronic tone as the door unlocks. The blast door hisses, shudders, and begins sliding horizontally to the right, gradually opening onto a wash of bright cold-blue light that spills across the corridor floor toward the characters.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.500, the shot cuts back to a wide shot from behind <Subject 2> and <Subject 3>, who are now standing shoulder to shoulder in the foreground, their silhouettes framed against the newly opened doorway and the cold-blue light pouring in from the room beyond. <Subject 2> (S1) says in the same controlled whisper: <d>[Chinese] 走。</d> They take their first steps forward together, moving in sync toward the open door as the camera holds a static composition and the blue light continues to brighten across the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
A low electrical hum and the faint hiss of recycled air circulate through the corridor throughout the video. Footsteps tap on the polished metal floor, fabric rustles softly as the two characters move, and a distant metallic clank is heard once from somewhere deeper in the passage. The blast door releases with a pressurized hiss and a heavy sliding scrape, while the locking mechanism emits a rising electronic tone.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained synth-pad drone at a slow tempo, layered with sparse low-pulse electronic beats that build subtly in volume as the door opens. Sustained high strings enter in the final shot, swelling underneath the dialogue and fading out as the characters step into the blue light at the end of the video.
